mod.name: Production Tuner
mod.description: Adjusts processing speeds, throughput, hydraulic rates and capacities for all machines, tools and vehicles.
Automatically scales dependent devices (hog pan, wave table, magnetite separator, trailers) to at least the bucket multiplier to prevent material loss.
config.group1_handtools.section: Group 1 - Hand Tools & Mobile Wash Plants
config.group1_handtools.simplemode.name: Simple Mode
config.group1_handtools.simplemode.desc: On: only the group multiplier is active. Off: individual sliders per component are enabled.
config.group1_handtools.group_multiplier: Shared multiplier for all hand tools and mobile wash plants (shovel, bucket, hog pan, mobile wash plant).
config.group1_handtools.shovel_fillspeed: How fast the shovel picks up material.
Maximum fill volume of the bucket.
Maximum fill volume of the hog pan (scales with bucket).
config.group1_handtools.mobilewashplant_: Processing speed of the mobile wash plant.
Maximum material capacity of the mobile wash plant.
config.group2_vehicles.simplemode.name: Simple Mode
config.group2_vehicles.simplemode.desc: On: only the group multiplier is active. Off: individual sliders per component are enabled.
Shared multiplier for all construction vehicles (excavators, wheel loader, backhoe loader, dump truck).
config.group2_vehicles.excavator_digspee: How fast all excavators dig (Mini and Large Excavator).
config.group2_vehicles.wheelloader_loads: How fast the wheel loader picks up and dumps material.
config.group2_vehicles.backhoeloader_loa: How fast the backhoe loader picks up and dumps material.
config.group2_vehicles.dumptruck_capacit: Maximum load capacity of the dump truck.

config.group3_washplantmodules.group_mul: Shared multiplier for all wash plant modules (hopper, conveyor, wash plants, sluice boxes, miner's moss).
config.group3_washplantmodules.hopper_ca: Fill capacity of the feed hopper.
config.group3_washplantmodules.conveyorb: Material capacity of the conveyor buckets.
config.group3_washplantmodules.washplant: Maximum processing capacity of all wash plants (Derocker, Glacier Creek, etc.).
Processing speed of all wash plants.

config.group3_washplantmodules.minersmos: Gold retention capacity of the miner's moss mats.
On: only the group multiplier is active. Off: individual sliders per component are enabled.
config.group4_fineprocessing.group_multi: Shared multiplier for all fine processing equipment (nuggetator, magnetite separator, wave table).
config.group4_fineprocessing.magnetitese: Separation speed of the magnetite separator.
Maximum input capacity of the magnetite separator (scales with bucket).
config.group4_fineprocessing.wavetable_s: Vibration speed of the wave table.
